questions.question: A company is planning a new workload. A company wants a managed relational database compatible with MySQL or PostgreSQL. Which service should it consider?
questions.explanation: Aurora is a relational database engine compatible with MySQL and PostgreSQL.

questions.question: A company is planning a new workload. An application should continue operating if one Availability Zone becomes unavailable. Which architecture should the company use?
